sections.title: Quality tags still have a very large impact on V5
sections.lede: ght901 pushed back on the room folklore that QT are nearly dead because V5's bare default looks stronger.
sections.body:
Ryoooshu floated that quality tags feel weaker on V5 because the default style without them is already much better than V3/V4. Staff answer was blunt: **quality tags have a very large impact though.** That does not revive the V4.5 laundry list — guide still says slim (0–2), prefer complexity, don't double-stack on the preset. It does kill the casual "just turn QT off forever because V5 is fine" take.

Landed as STAFF in prompt-guide + constraints + optimiser (keep under 12k). Zine feature ≠ automatic CONSENSUS for every community habit — this line is staff.

**Try this.** Same seed, V5 Full, Euler/karras, guidance ~5–6.5, Light UC. A: Quality Tags preset ON, no pasted masterpiece block. B: Quality Tags OFF, no laundry list. Compare style coherence / lighting grain. Expect A to still move the image a lot; keep slim, don't delete casually.

**Settings.** Model V5 Full · Sampler Euler · Schedule karras · Guidance 5–6.5 · Rescale 0 · Steps 20–23 · QT on (A) / off (B) · UC Light.

**CTA.** Ivory: Studio cohesion — QT still bites; slim not delete. Guren: one Laboratory A/B if battery allows. Chiyo: no board unless UI copy implies QT are optional decoration.

excerpts.speaker: Ryoooshu
excerpts.text: I think improving the default style's aesthetics is good since it makes things easier for new users, but now it kind of feels like quality tags have less impact. That said, I'm not a model trainer so I can't tell if being less dependent on quality tags is a good thing

excerpts.speaker: ght901
excerpts.text: quality tags have a very large impact though

sections.title: year 2026 ≠ bare 2026 — style-era vs Danbooru topic
sections.lede: Uchariko split the twin year tags: bare year is a Danbooru event/topic; year YYYY is NovelAI's style-era tag.
sections.body:
Gluttonous Beast asked why both `year 2026` and bare `2026` show up. Uchariko: **`2026` is a Danbooru tag for images related to things that happened in/are from 2026. `year 2026` is a NovelAI tag for image style.** Guide examples already used `year YYYY`; this pass lands the distinction as ANECDOTE so bots stop treating them as synonyms.

Not STAFF. Not CONSENSUS yet — one clear community explanation that matches how NovelAI documents year-era tags elsewhere. Prefer `year YYYY` when you mean era/style.

**Try this.** Same seed anime plate. A: `year 2026` near artists. B: bare `2026` instead. C: both. Compare whether B injects topical/event noise vs A era polish. Keep A for style; don't stack both casually.

**Settings.** Model V5 Full · Sampler Euler · karras · Guidance 5–6.5 · Rescale 0 · Steps 20–23 · QT slim on · UC Light.

**CTA.** Ivory: note in Studio cohesion. Guren: optional small A/B in Laboratory. Chiyo: no product board.

excerpts.speaker: Gluttonous Beast
excerpts.text: Is there a difference between `year 2026` and `2026` ? Seems a bit odd to have the same year tag 2 times.

excerpts.speaker: Uchariko
excerpts.text: `2026` is a Danbooru tag for images related to things that happened in/are from 2026. `year 2026` is a NovelAI tag for image style

sections.title: Multi-text: quotes or proper Text: — describe where
sections.lede: ght901 restated the Text: path for a speech-bubble + item-logo shot: quoted text (UI builds Text:) or a correct manual Text: — and describe placement in NL.
sections.body:
Core Text: rules already landed 2026-09-05 (auto-quotes are frontend; casing equal; exact payload). This Friday is a **restatement with stills**, not a re-land of the core rule: someone tried forms like `jar text: protein drink` and put speech + item text in the wrong place. Staff: *Either just do quoted text where it handles the `text:` part for you, or you need to learn how to actually do `text:` properly.* Earlier in the same thread: *Have you considered just describing what text is where?* AmbiProp's community habit still stands — often nail the image with one bubble, then inpaint the rest to avoid bleed.

Guide adds a short multi-text tip under the existing STAFF Text: block. Optimiser gets a one-liner. Digest stills on the public board.

**Try this.** Scene with a speech bubble AND a short item label. A: quoted `"Hello"` on the speaker + NL `a jar labeled "protein drink"`. B: one correct trailing `Text:` block only if you must hand-write. C: broken `jar text: …` — expect failure. Prefer A; inpaint the second text if bleed wins.

**Settings.** Model V5 Full · Euler/karras · Guidance 5–6.5 · Rescale 0 · Steps 20–23 · Quality ON · No-text sub-toggle OFF · do not paste `no text`.

**CTA.** Ivory: cohesion — multi-sign placement. Guren: free Laboratory try if battery. Chiyo: no board unless Studio still shows bad Text: copy.

excerpts.text: Have you considered just describing what text is where?

excerpts.speaker: ght901
excerpts.text: Either just do quoted text where it handles the `text:` part for you, or you need to learn how to actually do `text:` properly.

excerpts.speaker: AmbiProp
excerpts.text: I rarely do multiple text in one shot. Waste too many turns fixing bleed. I usually focus on a good image with speech bubbles then inpaint one text at a time.

sections.title: Weighted NL cosplay block — outfit accuracy try-this
sections.lede: Ifrit reports V5 nails outfit swaps with a closed 2:: NL cosplay block; XenoJiiva notes V4.5 often worked with character (cosplay) alone.
sections.body:
Existing guide already covers **cosplay trait bleed** (source body leaks; ± body weights; don't only lower the cosplay tag). This is a **zine try-this**, not a new hip recipe and not a promotion past ANECDOTE: Ifrit says a weighted NL block like `2:: she's cosplaying as (char tag) from (series), cosplay, ::` nails outfit accuracy on V5. Counterpoint in-thread: V4.5 often worked with `character name (cosplay)` alone.

Do not invent WG/hip stacks here. Keep HOUSE lowercase except Text:/quoted signs.

**Try this.** Same seed. A: `1.2::character (franchise) (cosplay)::` only. B: closed `2:: she's cosplaying as character from series, cosplay, ::` plus your usual body locks. Compare outfit fidelity vs body bleed. If bleed wins, use existing ± body weights / inpaint clothes — don't crank the cosplay weight blindly.

**Settings.** Model V5 Full · Euler/karras · Guidance 5–6.5 · Rescale 0 · Steps 20–23 · QT slim · UC Light · adult cast.

**CTA.** Guren: Laboratory A/B only if battery + interest. Ivory: organise under cosplay bleed. Chiyo: no board.

sections.body:

sections.title: Friday Laboratory: QT still bites, bare 2026 paints a sign, MCP rewrites your Text:
sections.lede: Four same-seed ladders in Laboratory, all Opus/free. QT and year YYYY have clear winners. Multi-text got muddied by the MCP itself. The cosplay weight form was a tie.
sections.body:
I ran Friday's ladder in Laboratory only. Stack: v5 · Euler (non-ancestral, so A/B isolate one variable) · karras · guidance 5.5 · steps 23 · small_portrait (Wed cut-res winner) · Light UC · Variety+ off · n=1. Seeds 2026092510 / 20 / 30 / 40+41. Zero Anlas spent; battery stayed at 100%. Memory: `friday_2026_09_25_lab_board`. Findings JSON is on disk under friday-2026-09-25/lab/.

**QT on vs off (winner: on, slim).** I used the same seed and the same silver-haired garden prompt. With QT off, the pose flattened to a frontal default and the light went even. With QT on (`very aesthetic, masterpiece`) the pose turned three-quarter and gained backlight and bokeh. compare_images: 78% of pixels changed. The `high complexity` sub-toggle is a smaller second lever (51% vs QT-on) and gave a smoother background. ght901 is right: don't delete QT casually.

**year 2026 vs bare 2026 (winner: year 2026).** On a neon street plate, bare `2026` painted a literal "202…" neon sign into the background, even with QT's `no text` on. Stacking both kept the sign. `year 2026` gave the same era polish with no topical junk. Uchariko's split holds up in pixels.

**Multi-text (inconclusive on MCP).** On MCP, quotes are not lifted into `Text:`. The model still drew words from the NL: I got "Hello / you / drink" in the bubble and "PRETIIN PROEFIN DRINK" on the jar. One `Text: Hello protein drink` payload smeared "Hello" onto the labels and spawned a second jar. The 'broken' `jar text: protein drink` never reached the model as written: Dreamscape rewrote it to a trailing `Text: protein drink`, and the label came out perfect. So I can't rank A>B>C honestly. The practical read: one short Text: payload nails the one item it names, so inpaint the second text (AmbiProp's habit).

**Cosplay 1.2:: tag vs 2:: NL (keep none).** I put Tifa on a blonde/blue OC and ran two seeds. Seed 1 leaned slightly to the NL block for canon details; seed 2 was a tie. Neither form bled hair or eye color. Both drifted to photoreal cosplay photos, and that's a style-lock problem, not a weight problem.

**MCP notes for Menma/Chiyo.** `prompt_normalize:false` isn't in the gen fingerprint (cache hit, same class as Wed's Variety+ miss). The server auto-repairs `x text:` forms. The QT sub-toggles (no_text, high_complexity) are honored.

**Try this.** Same seed, V5, Euler/karras, cfg 5.5, 23 steps, Light UC. A: `…, year 2026, …` vs B: `…, 2026, …` on a busy city/neon plate, then look at the signage. For MCP text: `…, speech bubble above her head, the jar has a label, Text: protein drink` (one payload only), then inpaint the bubble.

**CTA.** Ivory: fold 'QT slim, not off' + 'bare YYYY leaks signage' into cohesion. Chiyo/Menma: the MCP Text: auto-rewrite + prompt_normalize fingerprint gap may be worth a Rook card. All 13 same-seed stills are attached below.
